```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#batch read in raw HOBO files. Added column to dataframe for 2 HOBO replicates per site
SMR26_hobo_files <- list.files(
  here("raw data", "HOBO"),
  pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE
)
read_hobo <- function(path) {
  df <- read_csv(path, locale = locale(encoding = "cp1252"),
                 show_col_types = FALSE)
  fname <- basename(path)
  df |> 
    rename(
      index = `#`,
      datetime_raw = `Date-Time (EDT)`,
      Temp_C = starts_with("Temperature"),
      Light_lux = starts_with("Light")
    ) |> 
    mutate(
      Site        = str_remove(fname, "_[0-9]+\\.csv$"),
      Logger_rep  = str_extract(fname, "(?<=_)[0-9]+(?=\\.csv$)"),
      DateTime    = mdy_hms(datetime_raw, tz = "America/New_York")  # "EDT" in the header
    ) |> 
    select(Site, Logger_rep, DateTime, Temp_C, Light_lux)
}
 
SMR26_hobo_raw <- map_dfr(SMR26_hobo_files, read_hobo)
```
```{r}
#double checking interval and deployment window
SMR26_hobo_raw |> 
  arrange(Site, Logger_rep, DateTime) |> 
  group_by(Site, Logger_rep) |> 
  summarise(interval = names(sort(table(diff(DateTime)), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")
SMR26_hobo_raw |> 
  group_by(Site, Logger_rep) |> 
  summarise(start = min(DateTime), end = max(DateTime), .groups = "drop") |> 
  arrange(Site, Logger_rep)
```
```{r}
#trimming data to fit deployment window
trim_start <- ymd_hms("2026-06-23 20:00:00", tz = "America/New_York")  
trim_end   <- ymd_hms("2026-08-05 11:00:00", tz = "America/New_York") 
 
SMR26_hobo_trimmed <- SMR26_hobo_raw  |> 
  filter(DateTime >= trim_start, DateTime <= trim_end)
```
```{r}
SMR26_hobo_by_logger <- SMR26_hobo_trimmed |> 
  mutate(Date = as_date(DateTime)) |> 
  group_by(Site, Logger_rep, Date) |> 
  summarise(
    n_readings = n(),
    Temp_mean  = mean(Temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temp_min   = min(Temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temp_max   = max(Temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
    Light_mean = mean(Light_lux, na.rm = TRUE),
    Light_max  = max(Light_lux, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours_lit  = sum(Light_lux > 10, na.rm = TRUE) * 15 / 60,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
# Check the two replicates roughly agree before trusting the
# average - a big day-to-day gap between them could mean one
# logger is shaded, buried, or fouled differently from its pair.

SMR26_hobo_by_logger |> 
  select(Site, Logger_rep, Date, Temp_mean) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Logger_rep, values_from = Temp_mean, names_prefix = "Temp_rep") |> 
  mutate(diff = abs(Temp_rep1 - Temp_rep2)) |> 
  arrange(desc(diff))
 
SMR26_hobo_daily <- SMR26_hobo_by_logger |> 
  group_by(Site, Date) |> 
  summarise(
    n_loggers  = n_distinct(Logger_rep),
    Temp_mean  = mean(Temp_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temp_min   = min(Temp_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temp_max   = max(Temp_max, na.rm = TRUE),
    Light_mean = mean(Light_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Light_max  = max(Light_max, na.rm = TRUE),
    hours_lit  = mean(hours_lit, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
```{r}
summary_table <- SMR26_hobo_daily |> 
  group_by(Site) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean_daily_temp = mean(Temp_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_Mean_temp = sd(Temp_mean, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    Mean_max_daily_temp = mean(Temp_max),
    se_Mean_max_daily_temp = sd(Temp_max, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    Mean_daily_light = mean(Light_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_Mean_light = sd(Light_mean, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    Mean_max_daily_light = mean(Light_max),
    se_Mean_max_daily_light = sd(Light_max, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_table
```

```{r}
Mean_temp <- ggplot(
  data = SMR26_hobo_daily,
  aes(x = Date,
      y = Temp_mean,
      color = Site)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8,
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_classic()
```
